description: Line-by-line port of EMBOSS 6.6.0 `cons` (`embConsCalc`): per column the residue with the highest positive-match score under the scoring matrix (EDNAFULL for nucleotides, EBLOSUM62 for proteins) is chosen; if its positive-match weight is below `plurality` (default half the total weight) or fewer than `identity` residues are identical, the no-consensus symbol (`N` nucleotide / `X` protein) is emitted; residues whose weight is ≤ `setcase` are written in lower case. Gaps `-`, `.`, `~` are allowed. Single-precision arithmetic as in EMBOSS; outputs are character-identical to `cons -plurality P -identity I -setcase S` (780/780 reference runs). residueType 'auto' types the alignment exactly as cons does without -snucleotide/-sprotein (first sequence decides matrix and N/X; 3,700/3,700 reference runs) and padRaggedRows pads shorter rows with trailing gaps as cons does (ajSeqsetFill).

sequences.description: At least two aligned sequences (DNA or protein); equal length unless padRaggedRows

residueType.description: 'nucleotide' (EDNAFULL, default), 'protein' (EBLOSUM62) or 'auto' (decided from the first sequence like cons)

plurality.description: Minimum positive-match weight (cons -plurality); default half the total sequence weight

identity.description: Required number of identical residues (cons -identity, default 0 = off)

setcase.description: Weight at or below which output is lower case (cons -setcase); default half the total sequence weight

padRaggedRows.description: Pad rows shorter than the longest with trailing '-' (cons ajSeqsetFill) instead of rejecting them (default false)

consensus.description: Consensus sequence, one symbol per alignment column

errors.message: At least two sequences are required

examples.name: cons without a type flag, ragged rows
